briefing: Rep. Jimmy Gomez will resign from Congress after a House Ethics report, and Ukraine says it sank a Russian corvette in Libya. Trump held off an Iowa explosives detonation pending a court ruling. Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang, adding nearly $1 trillion in value, and Anthropic launched Claude Ship. The FDA approved the first drug for limb-girdle dystrophy. In Idaho, state revenue is $82.5 million above forecast.

sections.name: World and US
sections.brief: Rep. Gomez to resign; Ukraine says it sank a Russian ship in Libya.

articles.headline: Rep. Gomez to resign after House Ethics report
articles.summary: Gomez will resign Dec. 1 after a House Ethics report found substantial evidence of misconduct toward a staffer.

articles.headline: Ukraine says it sank Russian corvette in Libya
articles.summary: Zelenskyy says sea drones sank the Russian corvette Merkury at a Libyan port, 2,400 km from the front.

articles.headline: Trump orders Iowa explosives detonation held for court
articles.summary: Trump says the Army will wait for the Eighth Circuit before detonating five tonnes of explosives in Iowa.

articles.headline: Oxfam: Gaza environment severely contaminated
articles.summary: Oxfam says over 99% of Gaza shows contamination from the war. Israel says the report falls short of standards.

sections.name: Tech and AI
sections.brief: Huang back at Nvidia; Anthropic launches Claude Ship.

articles.headline: Huang returns as Nvidia CEO after Trump lobbying
articles.summary: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang less than two weeks after he resigned. Trump says he pushed for it.

articles.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Ship for code approvals
articles.summary: Claude Ship is a suite of AI agents that review, fix and can auto-approve routine code changes.

articles.headline: Ladybird browser alpha opens for testing
articles.summary: The independent Ladybird browser, built on a from-scratch engine, is in alpha on macOS and Linux after four years of work.

articles.headline: Virginia and Oregon sue SpaceX over Grok images
articles.summary: Virginia and Oregon are the first states to sue SpaceX, alleging Grok still generates sexualized images of real women and children.

articles.headline: Megaspeed headed for US export blacklist
articles.summary: Semafor reports the Commerce Department will add Singapore-based Megaspeed to its Entity List, limiting its access to US chips.

sections.name: Business and Healthcare
sections.brief: Nvidia adds nearly $1tn; FDA approves first LGMD drug.

articles.headline: Nvidia value jumps nearly $1tn as tech rallies
articles.summary: Nvidia shares rose more than 31% after Huang returned. The Nasdaq gained 6.5% and the S&P 500 rose 4.75%.

articles.headline: FDA approves first drug for limb-girdle dystrophy
articles.summary: The FDA approved BridgeBio's Welgemda for LGMD 2i/R9. The price works out to nearly $1 million a year.

articles.headline: Smart knee implants raise costs, patient concerns
articles.summary: Sensor-equipped joint implants are adding to health costs, and some patients say they did not know they received one.

articles.headline: Medicare for All returns as Democrats take Congress
articles.summary: New Democratic senators-elect campaigned on universal coverage, but past efforts split the party over how far to go.

articles.headline: Preventive services panel meets, votes in private
articles.summary: The USPSTF met for the first time since March 2025. Members voted in private on cervical cancer, perinatal depression and alcohol use.

sections.name: Idaho
sections.brief: State revenue runs $82.5M ahead; first CWD case in Unit 13.

articles.headline: Idaho revenues run $82.5 million above forecast
articles.summary: State revenue is 4.8% ahead of forecast four months into fiscal 2027, with a projected $688.3 million ending balance.

articles.headline: First CWD case found in Idaho Unit 13
articles.summary: A hunter-killed mule deer near the Oregon border tested positive for chronic wasting disease, the first detection in Unit 13.

articles.headline: Geothermal leak narrows Main Street in Boise
articles.summary: Main Street is down to one lane between 11th and 12th Streets while crews repair a geothermal leak, possibly for several days.

articles.headline: Boise Bench shop makes plant-based soap by hand
articles.summary: Mathair Earth, run by a mother and her daughters, makes soap and skincare in Boise and now has a storefront on Overland Road.
